Pinned Laserdata Skog inventory: ONE 24e002 City Mapper 2 campaign, captured 2024-02-03 to 2024-04-28, covering the AOI exclusively over items 24e002-636_68 (13,769,262 points, 0.649 returns/m2) and 24e002-637_68 (47,387,337 points, 1.811 returns/m2). The item boundary at N 6370000 is a provenance seam inside one campaign rather than a campaign seam, and it lies 562 m south of the southernmost played point. The scan is LEAF-OFF (February to April), so the deciduous under-detection recorded for Johannesberg and Upsala applies here; Kronholmen is pine and juniper ground, which limits it without removing it. record-laser-campaigns --check re-derives the live catalogue and fails on drift.

COPC headers, the COPC VLR and the full hierarchy pages for both items, read over authenticated range requests with no point bytes. Written by the ground-vegetation workflow, which re-pins this checksum in the same run because it rewrites the file every time it runs.

Nested resolution rings read from the Markhöjdmodell dtm-cog items over authenticated range requests: 1 m over the course (asserted against the published tiles), 2 m subsampled to 1.5 km, and the averaged overviews at 4, 8, 16 and 32 m to a 16 km root. Item identities (ETag, size, date) and the transfer are recorded; no credential material is.
